Every candidate's DOI/URL appeared in an API or page response retrieved in this session. Relevance notes paraphrase titles and snippets; items marked 'not deep-read' need verification before any matrix claim. No result claims are made.

candidates.why_relevant: Retrievable primary citation for the Allen stimulus set that NeuroSem's protocol list resembles. It resolves the unverified matrix entry. Table 2 and Figure 3 name these stimulus sets: Ramp (25 pA/s), Long Square (1 s steps in 20 pA increments), Short Square (3 ms), Short Square - Hold (-60/-70/-80 mV), Short Square - Triple, Noise 1 & 2 (scaled to rheobase), Ramp to Rheobase, Square 2 s Suprathreshold (rheobase +40/+80 pA) and Square 0.5 ms Subthreshold. The paper splits them into a fixed 'Core 1' sequence and a flexible 'Core 2' sequence, and states that model construction and testing is one design goal. Precedent for a standardized multi-protocol battery, but applied to biological cells, with no mutation or optimisation. The original help.brain-map.org URL went 404 around Dec 2023 and has redirected since Apr 2024 (IA CDX). Suggested citation URL: the community short-url, with the IA snapshot as a fallback.

candidates.title: BluePyOpt: Leveraging Open Source Software and Cloud Infrastructure to Optimise Model Parameters in Neuroscience
candidates.authors: Van Geit W, Gevaert M, Chindemi G, Rössert C, et al.
candidates.found_via: Crossref /works query.bibliographic
candidates.why_relevant: Multi-protocol, eFEL-feature-based objective for fitting neuron models. Partial overlap on protocols plus features; purpose is fitting, not change detection.

candidates.title: NeuroML-DB: Sharing and characterizing data-driven neuroscience models described in NeuroML
candidates.authors: Birgiolas J, Haynes V, Gleeson P, Gerkin RC, et al.
candidates.found_via: Crossref /works query.bibliographic (returned for NeuroML canonical query)
candidates.why_relevant: Characterises many NeuroML models under standard current-clamp protocols with electrophysiology properties. Partial overlap on a multi-protocol fingerprint across a NeuroML model corpus; also a fixture-model source.
